column1: # Expected import edges for the vue fixture.
# from<TAB>to, one per line. scripts/check.sh asserts this set exactly:
# a missing line is an edge the extractor stopped finding, an extra line
# is an edge it invented. Both are regressions.
# The layout is what create-vue (Vite) generates: tsconfig.json holds only
# `references`, the `@/*` alias lives in tsconfig.app.json, and Vite carries
# its own alias list in vite.config.ts.
# Of the twelve edges below, only four are relative imports. The other eight
# need an alias read from a config file:
# Edges that must NOT appear, and are therefore absent here:
#   src/App.vue       -> src/components/Ghost.vue   (a comment and two strings)
#   src/skipped.ts    -> src/api/client.ts          (@api: the value is a variable)
# Regenerate deliberately, never reflexively - the point of the file is
# that it does not move when the extractor changes.
